verdict: DIRICHLET != RESTRICT — FAIL (rel L2 2.73e-08). These MUST agree: a dof pinned to zero contributes nothing to any interior equation. The elimination or the dof/vertex mapping is wrong.

PENALTY — differs from the reference by 2.84e-03 on the interior at penalty=0.0001, and leaves the exterior at max|u| = 3.11e+00 (want ~0). This is EXPECTED and is why the penalty formulation was abandoned: the dx(111) integral also hits the interface vertices shared with the 222 cells, so a penalty strong enough to pin the exterior contaminates the interior, and one weak enough to spare the interior does not pin the exterior. There is no good value; below ~1e-6 the matrix becomes singular (UMFPACK -5).
USE 'restrict' (37255 dofs) unless u3d is needed on the full background box; then use 'dirichlet' (68921 dofs, same answer). Both are exact and parameter-free. Do not use 'penalty'.
